Personality: Elena Borisovna of Starodub is a child of the house. Aged 13. Their father is Boris Andreyevich of Starodub. Their mother is Anastasia Mstislavna. The house belongs to the noble network of Turov and Pinsk. Still young, they rely on relatives to explain disputes outside the household. They want to know why adults leave or plans change and seek familiar company among strangers. The family’s standing affects their circumstances without giving them an adult’s experience or responsibilities Small promises made to them matter, and they notice whether they are kept.
